verdict.rationale: Modal's official Python SDK lets users programmatically interact with the Modal platform, and official JS and Go SDKs can invoke Functions, use Sandboxes and manage some platform resources. Together these form a first-party programmatic API, backed by a documented CLI and LLM-readable docs. However, probes found no public OpenAPI/REST spec, and the JS/Go SDKs cover only part of the platform. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST HTTP API spec, evidence of in-depth SDK API reference docs, full platform coverage in the non-Python SDKs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: The [Modal](https://modal.com/) Python SDK allows you to deploy high-performance serverless applications and programmatically interact with the Modal platform.
The JS and Go SDKs allow you to use Modal Sandboxes, invoke deployed Modal Functions, and interact with some Modal platform resources.
